newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank sets one-week repo max limit 75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank sets one-week repo max limit 75 pct.

text.p: The Czech central bank (CNB) on Thursday set a one-week repo tender to drain funds from the market at a maximum limit of 75 percent, up from Wednesday's limit of 45 percent.
The CNB said in a statement it had set the deadline for bids at 10 a.m. (0800 GMT). It added that participants in the tender could submit two bids, with the minimum amount of 100 million crowns.
In Wednesday's auction, the previous limit was surpassed as the CNB allowed the market to determine the rate, which hit 56.63 percent.
The CNB holds repo tenders to regulate liquidity on the market almost daily.
The CNB raised its Lombard rate last Friday to 50 percent from 14 percent.
The CNB has said it would alter the repo rate flexibly according to marekt conditions.
